title: Parakou Headquarters — Banikanni
description: Our main site, where our dome biodigesters are designed and built. Here, agricultural and household biowaste is converted into biogas and Agri-Shell biofertilizer, in the heart of Borgou department.
results: A working biodigester producing biogas for cooking, with the digestate processed into liquid and granular Agri-Shell biofertilizer.
